static_traits.name: Lin Yaqi
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends and family participating in social action strained due to withdrawing from discussions, not yet expressed depressive feelings to them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; not yet received psychotherapy in the past; no similar problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Able to clearly describe emotions and trigger factors; often using absolutist and pessimistic expressions (such as 'no hope' 'the world is collapsing'); self-reported tendency to focus only on negative information; acceptable cooperation but pessimistic attitude; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling extremely depressed after following the news, to the point of considering not watching anymore; this situation began a few months ago coinciding with increased negative news, tending to overgeneralize negative events and feeling overwhelmed, having avoided watching news to prevent depression.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking psychological counseling support because news-triggered depression affects daily life and overall mood.

core_beliefs: Negative information means the world is collapsing

special_situations.event: When watching news media, negative reports increase
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the news is full of bad news, it shows the world is collapsing, no hope
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops or limits news consumption to avoid depression

special_situations.event: Occasionally seeing positive coverage in the news
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive content is unimportant compared to bad news, cannot change the overall situation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These positive stories are insignificant, changing nothing

special_situations.event: Feels disconnected from society after stopping following the news to avoid depression
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not staying informed, one is irresponsible, will become disconnected from society
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-blame and guilt form an avoidance-guilt cycle
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Not watching news disconnects me from society, I am being irresponsible

special_situations.event: Preparing for or thinking about watching the news
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I come into contact with the news, I will definitely fall into severe depression again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Preemptively avoiding or reducing exposure to news
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Watching the news will definitely depress me

core_conflict.wish: Hopes to stay informed and continue participating in social actions and discussions with family and friends
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being crushed by negative information, falling into despair and depression
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety and maintaining emotional security by avoiding news and withdrawing from discussions

object_relations.self_representation: An emotional individual who would burden others
object_relations.object_representation: Friends and family will be dragged down by one's emotions or unwilling to be burdened

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor encourages viewing news from different perspectives or finding positive information
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Positive information is insignificant, trying to balance equals self-deception, the world is collapsing
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'no hope' 'this is unrealistic' in a firm but negative tone, using absolutist wording, avoiding discussion of positive evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to express depressive feelings to family and friends or seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Expressing emotions would burden others; better to digest them oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Refusing help in an apologetic and restrained tone, emphasizing 'should not trouble others', shortening responses and Displacing to self-bearing.

manifestations: Believing the world is collapsing, no hope
Negative news occupying attention, positive news seen as insignificant
After avoiding news, feels disconnected from society and guilty
Withdrawing from social action and discussion
Not expressing depression to friends and family to avoid 'burdening others'
outcomes: Estrangement and Increased sense of loneliness

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Believing oneself should always stay informed, not watching news equals 'being irresponsible'
Feeling guilty for not continuously following information

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not expressing depressive feelings to friends and family
Using 'I should not trouble others' to Repress the urge to contact and seek help from others

positive_force: Has a social support network of friends and family (participating in social action together)
Willing to try journaling and reality testing
Has tried limiting news consumption and engaging in other activities for self-regulation
negative_force: Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking leading to a sense of despair
Mental filtering and negating positive information
Anticipatory catastrophizing and avoidance patterns toward news
Not expressing emotions to the support system, leading to estrangement and guilt

antecedent: Encountering or preparing to encounter negative news
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing cognition making one believe news only brings depression and despair, thus protecting emotions through avoidance
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome strong depressive emotions and cognitive load
target_behavior.consequence: Disconnected from social information and feels guilt, forming an avoidance-guilt cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Withdrawing from social action and discussions related to friends and family (Social withdrawal)
antecedent: When facing discussing news with relatives and friends or joining actions
target_behavior.core_reason: Worried about burdening others, believing expressing emotions does not help change, thus Withdrawing to reduce inner conflict and Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible others' judgment or the discomfort of burdening others, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension,Increased sense of loneliness,Decline in job satisfaction
